verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Raygun has language-specific integrations (JavaScript source maps, .NET client per community reports) and an external API access token for various services, implying SDKs exist, but there is no dedicated, comprehensive official SDK documentation set, package repository links, or coverage across multiple languages presented in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK reference docs, GitHub/npm/nuget package listings, multi-language coverage details, and independent verification of SDK completeness.
